It never guesses at who holds a seat: every name above is a certified result of
the general election of 5 November 2024, published by the State of Michigan.
This page dates them to that election rather than claiming the seat is still held.
149.lede: These are the people the State of Michigan certified as elected to %(county)s County's Board of Commissioners in the general election of 5 November 2024. They are the winners of that election, not a list the county keeps up to date, so a seat that has changed hands since will still show the person who won it.
149.standfirst: Everyone the State of Michigan certified as elected to the %(heading)s in the general election of 5 November 2024.
